status.semantics: Result reads do not require Demo.Enabled, ClaimEnabled or readiness, but HostClaim/store gates still return 503. Bearer scheme is case-sensitive. Before reservation, email_required/account_required includes expiresAt but no account list. Only done becomes claimed; aborted is terminal failure. recoveryPending is true for committed or aborting. No HTTP Retry-After is set by the normal status reply; respect JSON retryAfter=2 and any longer HTTP hint. Stop automatic polling after five minutes and retain flowToken for later result reads.

browser.auth: No bearer on GET; fragment is retained in the private console link, never sent in the HTTP request. The page exchanges it for a Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax browser cookie using same-origin forms, nonce and session CSRF.

browser.semantics: GET renders HTML without proving identity or reserving an app, including when admission is off. JavaScript clears the fragment before POST /demo/claim/intent, which creates the browser flow and redirects 303 to /demo/claim. Signed-out people enter email/code or use normal sign-in; Keymail continues OAuth. Signed-in identity is shown. Eligible owner/member accounts are shown with exact IDs; several require a choice, one is preselected, zero memberships require explicit personal-account confirmation. POST /demo/claim/select requires a valid session, nonce, CSRF and fresh auth before reservation; success redirects 303 to the page. Progress requires reload. Claimed HTML contains account ID, app and a permanent-URL link labelled Open app. Browser cookie is not an API flow token.

forms.errors: Form errors render HTML (400 malformed, 401 expired/proof, 403 origin/nonce/CSRF, 409 cap/placement/busy, 429 budget, 503 unavailable/reservation); invalid demo token at intent returns the shared JSON 401; unknown/foreign account selection is plain-text 404. Unauthenticated select redirects 303 to sign-in. Browser GET does not itself redeem the fragment.

complete.moved: Old host serves a no-store 200 HTML moved notice for GET/HEAD until original demo expiry, linking to the permanent app without an HTTP redirect. Other methods get 410 text. Expired notice no longer serves; retired/missing demo route gets 404.

availability.required: CARLOS_DEMO_APPS=1 and CARLOS_DEMO_CLAIM=1, no host-claim/store gate, and deployment readiness (including a ready mailer and Keymail OAuth). A merged producer alone does not enable claims.
availability.apiOrigin: Configured API origin, default console origin; all four JSON claim endpoints are allowed by the edge alias. Browser links use the console origin.
